name: cryosense
description: CryoSense: AI predictive maintenance for industrial refrigeration compressors

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
